data.sampling: deterministic uniform reservoir within each scene-group split
data.goal_proxy: nearest annotated ObjectNav goal view point (or goal position fallback) at the current state; deployment must supply an equivalent known semantic target waypoint

claims.observations: pose, relative currently nearest annotated goal waypoint, and strictly previous actions only
limitations: No RGB, depth, semantic map, obstacle map, or Unity source-code representation is used.
Habitat goal annotations supply candidate waypoints; deployment must provide equivalent current semantic-target positions without consulting a future trajectory.
The model selects only MOVE_FORWARD, TURN_LEFT, TURN_RIGHT, LOOK_UP, LOOK_DOWN, or STOP.
It is not an interaction policy, path planner, collision controller, cybersickness predictor, or complete Unity Brain.
Performance on held-out Matterport scenes does not establish human-like general navigation in arbitrary Unity projects.
